# Jeremiah 15 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Then the LORD said to me, "Even if Moses and Samuel were standing here pleading for these people, I still wouldn't have pity on them. Send them away! Get them out of My sight!

**2** God continued speaking to Jeremiah about the cost of following His calling.

**3** God continued speaking to Jeremiah about the cost of following His calling.

**4** God continued speaking to Jeremiah about the cost of following His calling.

**5** God continued speaking to Jeremiah about the cost of following His calling.

**6** God continued speaking to Jeremiah about the cost of following His calling.

**7** God continued speaking to Jeremiah about the cost of following His calling.

**8** God continued speaking to Jeremiah about the cost of following His calling.

**9** God continued speaking to Jeremiah about the cost of following His calling.

**10** What sadness is mine, my mother! I wish I had never been born! Everyone in the land argues with me and fights with me. I haven't lent money or borrowed any, yet they all curse me.

**11** God continued speaking to Jeremiah about the cost of following His calling.

**12** God continued speaking to Jeremiah about the cost of following His calling.

**13** God continued speaking to Jeremiah about the cost of following His calling.

**14** God continued speaking to Jeremiah about the cost of following His calling.

**15** God continued speaking to Jeremiah about the cost of following His calling.

**16** When I discovered Your words, I devoured them. They are my joy and my heart's delight, for I bear Your name, O LORD God of Armies.

**17** God continued speaking to Jeremiah about the cost of following His calling.

**18** Why does my suffering never end? Why is my wound so severe that it refuses to heal? Are You going to be as unreliable as a seasonal stream — full of water in the spring but dry when I need it most?

**19** Then the LORD replied, "If you come back to Me, I'll take you back and you'll serve Me again. If you speak what is worthwhile instead of what's worthless, you will be My spokesman. The people must come to you — you must not go to them.

**20** I'll make you like a bronze wall to these people — fortified and strong. They'll attack you, but they won't conquer you, because I am with you. I will protect you and rescue you," says the LORD.

**21** God continued speaking to Jeremiah about the cost of following His calling.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **15:1**: Jeremiah addresses Jeremiah's complaint — a message that confronted the comfortable assumptions of his audience.

- **15:10**: The refiner's fire image captures something profound — a truth the original audience would have immediately felt in their bones.

- **15:21**: God seals this message with His signature declaration — 'I have spoken' — leaving no room for negotiation.

— PNEUMA
